# Tomas Ameri — Portfolio & Blog

> Personal portfolio and blog of Tomas Ameri, a systems student and digital product builder exploring AI, technology, and design. The site is bilingual (English at `/en`, Spanish at `/es`).

Tomas Ameri builds digital products with a focus on marketplaces, automation, and applied artificial intelligence. This site showcases his projects, writing, and ways to get in touch. Content is available in English and Spanish; replace the `/en` prefix with `/es` for the Spanish version of any page.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.tomasameri.com/en): Overview, featured work, and links.
- [About](https://www.tomasameri.com/en/about): Background, skills, and interests.
- [Projects](https://www.tomasameri.com/en/projects): Selected products and experiments.
- [Blog](https://www.tomasameri.com/en/blog): Articles on AI, tech, and design.
- [Contact](https://www.tomasameri.com/en/contact): How to reach Tomas.

## Español

- [Inicio](https://www.tomasameri.com/es): Resumen y enlaces principales.
- [Sobre mí](https://www.tomasameri.com/es/about): Perfil, habilidades e intereses.
- [Proyectos](https://www.tomasameri.com/es/projects): Productos y experimentos destacados.
- [Blog](https://www.tomasameri.com/es/blog): Artículos sobre IA, tecnología y diseño.
- [Contacto](https://www.tomasameri.com/es/contact): Cómo contactar a Tomas.
